race.comment: LISTING CAPITAL (6) ran a cheeky race in the lead over 1200m at Murwillumbah two back then wasn't suited dropping back to 1100m at Beaudesert last start when easily accounted for. Gets some weight relief today and draws the fence so this sets up beautifully. PIPPIE POMAR (12) has been in the money at five of 12 runs. Led and was brave but eventually overhauled last time out over 1350m at Doomben. Meets an easier line-up this time and might be hard to catch. CAUTIONARY TAIL (7) has improved at each outing this prep, most recently clocking in fourth over 1350m at Doomben. Cherry ripe and in the right company to play a big role. GRAFTING (2) is back after a 24-week spell. Raced three times in the maiden campaign and was competitive on each occasion. Can give this a shake on the back of two recent trials. The speedy KOBI EXPRESS (5) steps up sharply in distance. If he settles expect a bold run out in front.
